aggregation_rule.base_component_combine: arithmetic mean over only components with existing *_defined == 1 flags; same deterministic defined-component rule as scripts/estimate_gaps.py
aggregation_rule.building_candidates: replace only the building component and its defined flag as specified by each already-validated feature-only component artifact
aggregation_rule.envelope_aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean of the six frozen full-score candidates; no weights are estimated or adjusted
aggregation_rule.facility_candidate: mean the 5 km facility catchment candidate with the existing v0 cbp_gap only when defined; if one half is undefined use the other; if neither exists the POI component is undefined
aggregation_rule.no_defined_component_fallback: if a component replacement leaves no defined outer component for a row, preserve that row's frozen C2 full-score prediction; count and disclose this no-new-defined-signal fallback by candidate
aggregation_rule.operator_review_rule: flag operator review if official-scope p95 candidate spread exceeds 0.10
aggregation_rule.spread: per official tract max(candidate score) - min(candidate score)

analysis: Frozen feature-derived candidate ensemble/envelope stability screen; no labels or accuracy measurement

C2_V0_MECHANISTIC.interpretation: definedness coverage from the frozen feature-derived component report; numeric scores remain present for every official tract

limitations: The equal-weight envelope mean is a declared diagnostic aggregation, not an accuracy-optimized prediction or submission proposal.
Candidate spread measures model-specification sensitivity only; no labels or authorized holdout scores are available to rank candidates.
Building morphology/source-prior and facility-catchment candidates remain analysis-only; this envelope does not satisfy approvals or prerequisites for a scored v2 assembly.
The existing v0 CBP component is retained only to make the facility-half replacement comparable; no new establishments sensitivity is incorporated.
A deterministic C2 fallback is used only if a component replacement leaves no defined full-score component; the fallback preserves an existing model prediction without target input.

deterministic_rerun.method: two complete builder invocations compared member CSV, envelope CSV, report, and manifest byte-for-byte

measure_before.definition: Existing source candidate distributions and feature/definedness availability before the frozen composition/envelope step.
